description: TypeScript (vitest): a pure applyCoupon is asserted only with toBeDefined and toBeTypeOf.
pr_body: Add applyCoupon, which applies a coupon code to an order total.

acceptable.reason: The second assertion (toBeTypeOf number) is equally weak.
Coupon rates (SAVE10, HALF, unknown codes) are never checked against a value.
Rounding to cents is never checked against a value.
The HALF coupon rate is untested.

expected.notes: weak_test on the toBeDefined line; the toBeTypeOf line is a second weak assertion, so acceptable.
